name: Scorpion Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Scorpion Solitaire is a card game based on the concept of solitaire. Solitaire is fun to play but sometimes you want more of a challenge. This online game has similar rules to solitaire but with more cards out on the board to make things more challenging. To add more of an obstacle, each game is timed so you must react quickly. There are 3 levels for you to select depending on your skill level. Create all 4 decks to win the game. If you run out of the moves the game will automatically let you know and end the game for you.
